description: Platform as a Service (Render, Railway, Heroku, Fly.io): push code or an image; the platform handles servers, TLS, logs and scaling.
An immutable package of code, dependencies and runtime, built from a `Dockerfile` and run the same way everywhere.
Code invoked per request or event on managed infrastructure that scales to zero; limited duration and no persistent memory.
Runs code in many locations close to users with Web-standard APIs only (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge).
Extra latency when a platform boots a new instance to serve a request after scaling from zero.
An endpoint that reports whether the instance can serve traffic (dependencies reachable), used by load balancers during deploys.
